examples.text: Die Diffusion durch eine selektiv permeable Membran heißt Osmose.

translations.source_sense_description: Biologie, Physik, Chemie: die Durchlässigkeit eines Materials betreffend

glosses: Able to be permeated; absorbing or allowing the passage of fluids.

examples.text: Rainwater sinks through permeable rock to form an underground reservoir.
One hundred thirty-one small, highly permeable masonry wall specimens built of concrete blocks or of bricks were treated with cement-water paints or with other waterproofings.

glosses: Allowing the passage of persons, information, or other things, especially when such passage occurs despite hopes or expectations otherwise.

translations.source_sense_description: Biologie, Physik, Chemie: die Durchlässigkeit eines Materials betreffend

examples.text: Użyli złego, przemakalnego materiału i w czasie ulewy zaraz byliśmy cali mokrzy.
